question: Does a coarse, earlier individual trend-deterioration exit improve the fixed RS-veto system's completed trade economics consistently enough to justify one portfolio replay?
honesty_boundary: Four coarse MA/confirmation alternatives, the simple-cycle population, counterfactual semantics, and promotion gate are fixed before accepted estimates. This is consumed 2018-2023 research.

population.simple_cycle: exactly one filled new-position buy and one filled completed-round-trip sell, with no intervening filled rebalance leg
population.reason: preserves exact entry capital and avoids inventing counterfactual cash flows for path-dependent rebalances
population.coverage_policy: report exclusions; do not generalize screen estimates to complex rebalanced cycles

counterfactual_contract.signal: at completed close t, every required trailing close is below its own trailing MA; histories reproduce the engine's corporate-action rebasing and contiguous hard-valid bar requirement
counterfactual_contract.execution: full exit at the first executable open after signal t; never fill inside signal bar t
counterfactual_contract.t1: signal cannot execute before the session after acquisition
counterfactual_contract.failed_open: pending exit advances to the next executable sell open before the current actual exit; otherwise preserve actual exit
counterfactual_contract.corporate_actions: apply only visible valid non-rights share/cash actions; fail closed on blocking, invalid, unavailable, or rights actions
counterfactual_contract.price_and_cost: raw open with the frozen 10 bps sell cost; actual entry notional plus entry cost is the denominator
counterfactual_contract.non_early_signal: preserve actual completed return because existing market, set-change, and individual exits remain active

diagnostics: earlier-exit activation count and trading-session lead

promotion_gate.strong: mean return improves by at least 1 percentage point in both blocks and severe-loss rate is no worse in either
promotion_gate.risk: severe-loss rate improves by at least 5 percentage points in both blocks, while mean return is no worse by more than 1 percentage point in either
promotion_gate.failure: if no rule passes, exit remains unresolved and no replay is run

prohibited: using future path information to form an exit signal
screening additional MA or confirmation combinations
more than one executable exit replay
